label: Program Newsletter · October 2026
headline: News from the
paragraphs: Arroyo Chamiso is Santa Fe's first non-congregate transitional housing village, run in partnership with The Life Link. Since April 2024 it has given 59 residents a locked door of their own, and 22 have moved on to permanent housing.
This month's issue covers the village's story, resident artwork, a field trip, partner programs, and how to donate.
